author: GamingBolt
description:
In part one of our multi-part recap of the Resident Evil series, we kicked things off with- well, let’s just call it what it was-: a lore dump. This is Resident Evil, after all, which means there’s an insane amount of important backstory to go into. 

Here in part two, however, we’re finally ready to move into the overarching story of Resident Evil proper- starting with Resident Evil 0 and Resident Evil 1, the first chronological games in the series. 

With that out of the way, let’s begin!

Link to Part 1: https://youtu.be/oK5XrDkTJ8E
title: Resident Evil 0 FULL STORY EXPLAINED - Part 2 - Before You Play Resident Evil Requiem

author: GamingBolt
description:
If this Xbox Developer_Direct proved anything – aside from the fact that Game Freak can make a visually gorgeous title when given the opportunity – it's that you should never bet against Playground Games. Opening the show with Forza Horizon 6 and showcasing its gorgeous take on Japan is one thing, but the main attraction was Fable. 

As Xbox's biggest exclusive this year, perhaps of the past many years, it had to deliver, never mind living up to the legacy of Lionhead's classics, and after so many delays, surely something had to give.

But lo and behold, Playground knocked it out of the park.
title: This Is One of The Most AMBITIOUS Open World Games We Have Ever Seen
